extracted.name: Simple Baked Apples
extracted.description: This is a family standard. We have it at least once a week during the winter. The spices, nuts and raisins can be interchanged or omitted depending upon your tastes. Serve with oatmeal, French toast, pancakes, or as a side dish.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart casserole dish, or coat with cooking spray.

Place apples in a large bowl. Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves in a small bowl; stir into apples until evenly distributed. Stir in raisins and walnuts. Spoon into prepared dish. Pour milk over apple mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until soft and bubbly, 45 to 60 minutes. Allow to cool slightly before serving.
